description: This file defines the EvaluationRunTracerLlama class, which manages callback hooks for tracking evaluation metrics, token counts, and timing for language model evaluation runs within a larger system. It also includes a utility function for extracting text from message content.

classes.name: EvaluationRunTracerLlama
classes.description: A class that manages callback hooks for tracking evaluation metrics, token counts, and timing for language model evaluation runs.

methods.name: constructCallBacks
methods.description: Initializes callback functions for various events related to language model evaluation, such as start, end, stream, retrieve, and agent events.

methods.name: calculateAndSetMetrics
methods.description: Calculates metrics like token counts and timing for a given event and updates the evaluation metrics accordingly.

methods.name: injectEvaluationMetadata
methods.description: Injects evaluation run ID metadata into node data and caller object for evaluation tracking.
